caseName: Union Trust Co. v. Eastern Air Lines, Inc.
caseNameFull: Union Trust Co. v. Eastern Air Lines, Inc.
attorneys: David G. Bress, Sheldon E. Bernstein, Alvin L. Newmyer and Jo V. Morgan, Jr. for petitioners. Joseph W. Henderson, Richard W. Galiher and John M. Aherne for respondent.

opinions.text:
On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit.

Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted and the judgment is reversed.*

Mr. Justice Frankfurter and Mr. Justice Harlan would not grant certiorari.

Modified, post, p. 962.
